messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging steph_oncall: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for private-vpc cluster 'acme-prod' (region-us-west-2). Alert group: vpc-egress-errors.

pagerduty: Triggered on-call: steph_oncall (1min ago). Incident priority: P1.

steph_oncall: I'm on it. Initial check — dashboards show 5xx rate spiking at ~08:03 UTC and sustained. Which customers impacted?

kate_support: AcmeApp reporting errors in production, multiple 502/504s to our /infer gateway. Customer impact: request failures for ~30% of generating requests starting ~08:03.

marco_sre: Logs show gateway returning "upstream connection reset" and "connect timeout" from gateway -> inference workers. Hypothesis: egress failure or NAT port exhaustion.

steph_oncall: @amir_networks can you confirm if any peering/route changes or firewall rules rolled in the window?

amir_networks: No intentional change recorded. Checking VPC flow logs and SG rules now. Pulling conntrack stats on NATs.

tina_runtime: Adding that the serving runtime is healthy: GPU pools show steady CPU/GPU load, KV cache hitrates normal. Problem seems networked — requests get to router but time out reaching model pods.

marco_sre: Attaching snippets of gateway error logs: ```
[08:04:12] upstream error: connection reset by peer
[08:04:12] context deadline exceeded while awaiting headers
[08:04:13] 502 Bad Gateway: dial tcp 10.32.45.67:443: i/o timeout
```

steph_oncall: Good. Amir — do flow logs show SYN/FIN patterns or RSTs? Any asymmetric routing?

amir_networks: Flow logs show bursts of ephemeral port reuse and a large number of connections in CLOSE_WAIT on the NAT instance. I see conntrack table near capacity (around 98%). Suspect conntrack exhaustion on the managed NAT gateway.

steph_oncall: That would explain ephemeral connection failures and timeouts. What's the immediate mitigation?

amir_networks: Short-term: rotate traffic to a different NAT gateway / add an extra managed NAT to the private subnet. I'm initiating failover to nat-2 in us-west-2a and increasing conntrack timeout thresholds.

marco_sre: While that happens, recommend reducing client-side connection lifespan: enable keepalive reuse and lower per-request TCP open/close rate via short-term connection pooling in the gateway. Can we flip an autoscaling rule to add more gateway replicas?

tina_runtime: Gateway replicas already at 6. I can temporarily double gateway pod count and enable long-lived HTTP/1.1 keepalives to reuse sockets. Doing rollout now with `kubectl -n gateway scale deploy/gw 12`.

steph_oncall: Kate, please post a brief status update to AcmeApp support channel: we're aware, root cause suspected NAT conntrack exhaustion, mitigation in progress, ETA 10-15m.

kate_support: Posted to customer Slack and created a support ticket: INC-18422. Customer notified with apology and ETA.

incident-bot: Action log: steph_oncall assigned, amir_networks investigating, tina_runtime scaling gateway, marco_sre collecting logs.

amir_networks: NAT rotation initiated -> target nat-2 online, updating route table to use nat-2, removing some stale conntrack entries. Manual conntrack flush scheduled on nat-1 after draining.

marco_sre: After switching to nat-2, 5xx rate dropped from 30% to ~4% within 90s. Gateway timeouts decreased. Correlating metrics show connections established to inference pods recovering.

steph_oncall: Excellent. Keep monitoring for recurrence and check other VPCs that use nat-1. Which customers were behind nat-1?

amir_networks: Lists show acme-prod + 3 smaller customers on nat-1. I'll coordinate migration for the others and plan a scheduled maintenance to increase conntrack limits or migrate to managed NAT gateway with autoscaling.

tina_runtime: Rolling back temporary scale to 8 (from 12) but keeping keepalive enabled for 30m. Logging will remain verbose for gateway->pods for 1hr.

steph_oncall: Incident summary so far: root cause likely NAT conntrack exhaustion causing upstream dial timeouts -> gateway 5xx. Immediate mitigations: route failover to nat-2, increased gateway replication, enabled keepalives. Customer impact: AcmeApp saw ~30% failures for ~5-12m; now largely recovered.

kate_support: Customer confirms errors dropped after your update; they asked for RCA and long-term fix plan.

marco_sre: Next steps: amir to run conntrack capacity increase + autoscaling plan; ops to add alert for conntrack >85%; runtime to add connection pooling defaults for gateway clients; postmortem in incidents/ postmortems folder in 24-48h.

steph_oncall: Assigning owners: amir_networks -> NAT hardening & autoscale plan; tina_runtime -> gateway connection pooling defaults; marco_sre -> postmortem + timestamped logs; kate_support -> customer RCA draft.

incident-bot: Incident P1 closed to mitigated state at 08:25 UTC. Please add follow-ups and tag #postmortems when ready. :white_check_mark:"
